message.content: The main visible subject is a stylized illustration of a red backpack (or small suitcase) with dark navy/black trim, a top handle, a horizontal cream stripe near the top, a cream rectangular label, and a larger lower pocket with a cream zipper line and a small tab. The background is a plain light gray/off-white, with a soft gray shadow beneath the object. The setting is a minimalist web interface (a browser-style page) featuring a top navigation bar with red, yellow, and green dots and the text "Object study / illustrated demo," a label "ILLUSTRATION / visual retrieval test," and a footer reading "SYNTHETIC DEMO / no personal information." The colors are limited to red, dark navy/black, cream/off-white, and light gray.
